name: Uniform Marching Cubes with Snapping
definition: A uniform-grid polygonization algorithm that computes cell topology masks from coarse grid vertex signs and optionally snaps iso-surface vertices to edges by minimizing distance to grid vertices.
summary: Uniform Marching Cubes with Snapping is a polygonization algorithm that reduces geometric error by snapping iso-surface vertices to grid edges, distinguishing it from standard UMC.
